title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 25
statement: A point \(P\) is chosen at random inside square \(ABCD.\) The probability that \(AP\) is neither the shortest nor the longest side of \(\triangle APB\) can be written as \(\dfrac{a + b\pi - c\sqrt{d}}{e},\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c,\) \(d,\) and \(e\) are positive integers, \(\gcd(a, b, c, e) = 1,\) and \(d\) is not divisible by the square of a prime. What is \(a + b + c + d + e?\)

solutions.text: Place \(A = (0,0)\) and \(B = (1,0)\) on the unit square. \(AP\) is the middle length when \(BP \lt AP \lt AB\) or \(AB \lt AP \lt BP.\) These regions are bounded by the circle centered at \(A\) with radius \(1\) (where \(AP = AB\)) and the line \(x = \tfrac12\) (where \(AP = BP\)). Let \(S\) be where the circle meets \(x = \tfrac12.\) Then \(\triangle ABS\) is equilateral, so \(\angle BAS = 60^\circ.\) The larger region has area \(\frac{4\pi - 3\sqrt3}{24}\) and the smaller has area \(\frac{12 - 2\pi - 3\sqrt3}{24}.\) They add to \(\frac{6 + \pi - 3\sqrt3}{12}.\) Thus \(a + b + c + d + e\) \(= 6 + 1 + 3 + 3 + 12\) \(= 25.\) Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Set \(A = (0,0), B = (1,0);\) \(AP\) is the middle length when either \(BP \lt AP \lt AB\) or \(AB \lt AP \lt BP\)
The boundaries are the circle \(AP = 1\) (about \(A\)) and the vertical line \(AP = BP;\) use the \(60^\circ\) sector where \(\triangle ABS\) is equilateral
